The [[Island of Shehkah]] is the starting location for newly created characters in the [[Nightfall]] campaign, spawning here after completing the character creation process. This is considered the tutorial area for Nightfall characters, and as such, characters are usually not able to return to this location after they leave. However there's still a way to map the area. See the notes section below.

==Mission information==
===Objectives===
Speak to Kormir.
*Follow Kormir's instructions. (''Added with Rally the Recruits (Tutorial)'')
*Reach the Sunspear watch post.
*Speak to First Spear Jahdugar. (''Added with Into Chahbek Village'')
*Reach Chahbek village. (''Added at the watchpost'')

==Notes==
* Elonian characters will be able to explore all of the area during the "Rally the Recruits" tutorial; the "Take the shortcut" quest does not allow access to the Eastern area of the island beyond the resurrection shrine (restricting exploration to only 0.5%). It should be noted that the Elonian [[Cartographer]] title can still be maxed without fully exploring this area. The only known other way to explore this area is by using a [[gate glitch]] from Churrhir Fields.
* Fully exploring this area amounts to 0.8% of Elona.
*This instance can be re-entered by any Nightfall character who has not started [[Take the Shortcut (Skip Tutorial)]] or [[Into Chahbek Village]].
**Re-entry requires [[ferry]]ing from any character currently in this instance, as there are no entrances to this instance.
**Resigning from this instance will return you to the start of this instance ''only'' if you do not have any outposts unlocked; any party members who do not meet this requirement will instead be sent to the last outpost they were in.
*Returning to this instance from the [[Guild Hall]] will allow party sizes of up to 8.
